SELECT agent_run_logs.log_id, agent_run_logs.run_id, agent_run_logs.event_key, agent_run_logs.agent_name, agent_run_logs.node, agent_run_logs.event, agent_run_logs.kind, agent_run_logs.payload, agent_run_logs.created_at, task_events.task_event_id FROM agent_run_logs LEFT OUTER JOIN task_events ON task_events.agent_run_log_id = agent_run_logs.log_id WHERE agent_run_logs.run_id = $1::UUID AND agent_run_logs.event_key = $2::VARCHAR

INSERT INTO agent_run_logs (log_id, run_id, event_key, agent_name, node, event, kind, payload) VALUES ($1::UUID, $2::UUID, $3::VARCHAR, $4::VARCHAR, $5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR, $7::VARCHAR, $8::JSONB) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_agent_run_logs_event DO NOTHING RETURNING agent_run_logs.log_id, agent_run_logs.run_id, agent_run_logs.event_key, agent_run_logs.agent_name, agent_run_logs.node, agent_run_logs.event, agent_run_logs.kind, agent_run_logs.payload, agent_run_logs.created_at
SELECT agent_runs.task_id FROM agent_runs WHERE agent_runs.run_id = $1::UUID
